answer: An operator copying one text across 111 aliases as a result pays for 111 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the falcon hash is stored at intake, the opal graph groups the endorsements and the signal audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
